The induction checks the minimizing-state multiplicities, not just costs: remaining heights 1,2,0 modulo 3 give respectively unique A; unique B with a=b+1; and c<a=b=c+1, B with exactly d minimizers. Root C is infeasible. Thus h=3t+1 has unique D=∪L_3j, h=3t+2 unique D=∪L_{3j+1}, and h=3t≥3 has D=(∪L_{3j+2})∪{v}, v∈L_0∪L_1; h=0 is singleton. No uniform branching is assumed.
